message:
Now I need to understand the use-after-free. The crash is in `HashMgr::add_word` called from `HashMgr::load_tables`. Let me look at how `HENTRY_DATA` and `HENTRY_FIND` macros work, and how the `hentry` struct is used with the `word` array.

Let me look at the `HENTRY_DATA` and `HENTRY_FIND` macros:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -rn "HENTRY_DATA\|HENTRY_FIND" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hunspell/src/hunspell/*.hxx /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hunspell/src/hunspell/*.cxx | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
